description: Source code implementing a BSD-specific backend for fsnotify, utilizing kqueue for event notification on FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD, Dragonfly BSD, and Darwin (macOS). It defines structures and methods for managing file watches, handling events, and integrating with the kqueue system call.

classes.name: kqueue
classes.description: Represents a kqueue-based watcher, managing event loop, file descriptors, and associated watches.

classes.name: watches
classes.description: Manages the collection of watched files and directories, including their states and relationships.

classes.name: watch
classes.description: Represents an individual watch on a file or directory, including metadata such as name, link, and flags.

methods.name: newWatches
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new watches collection.

methods.name: listPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of paths currently being watched, optionally filtering for user-added watches.

methods.name: watchesInDir
methods.description: Returns a list of watched files within a specified directory.

methods.name: addUserWatch
methods.description: Marks a path as added by the user.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a symbolic link to the watch collection.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new watch for a specified path, with link resolution and directory handling.

methods.name: byWd
methods.description: Retrieves watch info by file descriptor.

methods.name: byPath
methods.description: Retrieves watch info by path.

methods.name: updateDirFlags
methods.description: Updates directory flags for a watched directory.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a watch by file descriptor and path.

methods.name: markSeen
methods.description: Marks a path as seen or unseen.

methods.name: seenBefore
methods.description: Checks if a path has been seen before.

methods.name: newBackend
methods.description: Creates a new kqueue backend, initializing event channels and starting event reading.

methods.name: newKqueue
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new kqueue system, including a pipe for shutdown signaling.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the kqueue, removing all watches and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a watch for a specified path.

methods.name: AddWith
methods.description: Adds a watch with additional options.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a watch for a specified path.

methods.name: WatchList
methods.description: Returns a list of all currently watched paths.

methods.name: addWatch
methods.description: Internal method to add a watch, resolving symlinks and setting flags.

methods.name: readEvents
methods.description: Main loop for reading and processing kqueue events, converting them into fsnotify events.

methods.name: newEvent
methods.description: Creates a platform-independent Event object from kqueue event data.

methods.name: watchDirectoryFiles
methods.description: Adds watches for all files within a directory, mimicking Linux inotify behavior.

methods.name: dirChange
methods.description: Checks a directory for new or changed files and generates create events.

methods.name: sendCreateIfNew
methods.description: Sends a create event if a file is new and starts watching it.

methods.name: internalWatch
methods.description: Internal method to watch a file or directory, resolving symlinks and setting appropriate flags.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers file descriptors with the kqueue for specific events.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads pending events from the kqueue.

methods.name: xSupports
methods.description: Checks if certain operations are supported on the current platform.
